engine: unmodified MemoryEngine.retain_batch_async / recall_async / update_memory_unit / delete_memory_unit / get_memory_unit

mapping.source: exact text retained as raw chunk with llm_provider=none
mapping.scope: one bank per case and sourceSuffix; no authenticated ACL equivalence
mapping.tags: exact caller tags retained; no query tag filter
mapping.association: One shared opaque entity per unordered endpoint pair via supported entities and resolve_entities=false. Original direction and exact label retained in source metadata. Co-occurrence is undirected, not a directed free-label association API. Reciprocal pairs share the same entity.
mapping.inference: Native semantic links may also be generated by retention. No fabricated SQL writes, graph seeds, scores or stored facts.

embedding.queryPrefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

common.maxTokens: fixture tokenBudget or1024; native tokenizer rather than Lite byte ceiling
common.keyword: native PostgreSQL text search, no caller-provided candidates
common.order: Control then treatment per iteration, same bank and sources

boundaries: No hosted service or extraction LLM; actual local embedding model executes.
Retained response snapshots are historical client data, not refreshable receipts.
No authenticated owner revocation or forced conflict-abstention equivalence is claimed.
No cross-product timing or token win-rate: model, transport, candidate and token-budget semantics differ.
No threshold or fixture tuning after observation.
